title: Error handling and typed throws
hints: func parseAge(_ text: String) throws(AgeError) -> Int { guard !text.isEmpty else { throw .empty }; guard let n = Int(text) else { throw .notANumber(text) }; ... }
With typed throws, `catch` gives you an AgeError directly: do { ... } catch { switch error { case .empty: ... } }.  try? turns a throw into nil.
